Sasha: Heads-up — customers seeing token spikes when clients reconnect and a stream gets truncated mid-toolcall. Console shows provisional + confirmed tokens double-counting.
Ara: Any repro or logs? :thinking_face:
Sasha: Tiny repro: start a streaming toolcall, drop the connection around the last chunk, client reconnects and resumes. Ledger shows suffix tokens attributed to both sessions.
Sasha: Repro log:
```
[router] session_start id=abc123
[worker] toolcall chunk seq=45 bytes=120
[router] conn_lost id=abc123
[router] resume start=46 session=def456
[worker] toolcall truncation eof=45
[ledger] add provisional tokens session=abc123 range=1-45
[ledger] add confirmed tokens session=def456 range=46-80
```
Mike: Is the router claiming ownership of trailing partial suffix before worker confirms EOF? "Claim-on-handoff" heuristics have bitten us before.
Jordan: Sounds like a race — resume path creates a new session and ledger bookkeeping treats truncated suffix as owned by both old provisional session and new confirmed session.
Ara: Paste the resume protocol headers? Curious if session id or seq boundaries differ.
Sasha: Resume handshake (simplified):
```
POST /v1/streams/resume
Headers: Session-Id: def456; Resume-From: token-46
Body: { last_ack: 45 }
```
Eva: I think the core is our prefix/suffix capture window for provisional credits. If we don't tombstone the old provisional on handoff, UI + billing show temporary credit until reconciliation.
InfraBot: Alert triggered: infra/ledger-sampling-2 at 2026-03-05T10:12Z
Mike: Two options: (A) delay router provisional write until worker confirms EOF for suffix tokens (adds edge latency) or (B) add reconciliation flag in ledger and surface provisional vs confirmed in console so customers see "provisional pending".
Jordan: (B) is lower-risk but moves complexity to billing reconciliation and UI explanations.
Ara: Also consider partial-toolcall semantics: require an idempotency token on resume so ledger can dedupe. Not all clients set it though.
Sasha: Idempotency helps but we need defense-in-depth.
Eva: UX note — if we do (B) add a per-route dashboard tile showing provisional token %, with a link to reconciliation details to reduce ops noise.
Mike: Add streaming metric "resume_revs" with labels {route, cause=truncate|client_drop} so we can quantify how often this happens.
Ara: Agreement: short-term -> console provisional flag + dashboard annotation; medium-term -> router change to prefer confirmed EOF claims; long-term -> require/enc token in SDK and validate in gateway.
Sasha: I'll open an RFC for router change and include perf simulation for added latency. Will add a repro harness so SRE can stress-test.
Jordan: I'll mock dashboard tile and console banner for provisional tokens. Ping when API for reconciliation flags is ready.
Eva: Updating runbook with troubleshooting checklist: how to find orphaned provisional sessions and force-reconcile.
Sasha: Quick asks: @Mike can you add metric stub to ingestion proto? @Ara can you file ledger migration tickets? I'll start RFC.
Mike: On it — PR for proto today.
Ara: Filing tickets now.
InfraBot: CI queued: tests/stream-resume-harness on infra-ci-3
Sasha: Sync tomorrow 11am PT for a short design walkthrough. :thumbsup:
